# eBay Canada

> eBay Canada is a comprehensive online marketplace offering electronics, cars, fashion, collectibles, and more with integrated selling tools, daily deals, and account management features.

eBay Canada provides a full-featured e-commerce platform for buying and selling a wide variety of items, with robust account security, seller resources, and personalized shopping experiences. The platform emphasizes user authentication and fraud prevention across all account-related operations.

## Key Topics

- eBay Canada marketplace
- Account authentication
- Identity verification
- Security measures
- Fraud prevention
- My eBay dashboard
- Seller tools
- Daily deals
- Refurbished items
- Advanced search
- My Garage (automotive)
- Purchase history
- Watchlist management
- Messaging center
- Account protection

## Marketplace & Shopping

- [eBay Canada Homepage](https://www.ebay.ca): eBay Canada homepage with marketplace categories, auctions, and featured products
- [Daily Deals on eBay](https://www.ebay.ca/deals): eBay daily deals with discounts on electronics and refurbished items
- [Advanced Search](https://www.ebay.ca/sch/ebayadvsearch): eBay advanced search with filters, categories, and location options
- [My Garage](https://www.ebay.ca/g/mygarage): eBay My Garage for vehicle-specific parts and automotive accessories

## Account & Authentication

- [Sign in or Register](https://signin.ebay.ca/ws/eBayISAPI.dll): eBay account login and registration with social authentication options
- [Security Verification](https://signup.ebay.ca/pa/crte): eBay account security verification and identity confirmation page
- [My eBay Dashboard](https://www.ebay.ca/mys/home): eBay account dashboard with fraud prevention and identity verification
- [My eBay Summary](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/summary): eBay My eBay summary page with account security measures

## Buying & Account Management

- [Purchase History](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/purchase): eBay purchase history page with identity verification and security
- [Watchlist](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/watchlist): eBay user watchlist with security verification requirement
- [Bids and Offers](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/bidsoffers): eBay bids and offers tracking with account security verification
- [Saved Items](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/saved): eBay saved items page with fraud prevention and user authentication

## Selling & Support

- [Selling on eBay](https://www.ebay.ca/sl/sell): eBay seller guide with listing basics, fees, and how-to-sell tutorials
- [eBay Customer Service](https://www.ebay.ca/help/home): eBay help center with FAQs, buying/selling guides, and customer support

## Optional

- [Saved Searches](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/savedsearches): eBay saved searches page with account protection verification
- [Saved Sellers](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/savedsellers): eBay saved sellers list with security verification and user safety
- [Reviews and Feedback](https://www.ebay.ca/mye/myebay/rvi): eBay account page for reviews and feedback with security verification
- [Messaging Center](https://mesg.ebay.ca/mesgweb/ViewMessages/0): eBay messaging center with account security and identity verification
